query: 结社自由与集体谈判 结社自由与集体谈判 衡量企业保障员工自愿组建、加入工会等组织，并以此与雇主进行有关薪酬、福利、工作条件等事项集体协商权利的程度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：发布了明确的结社自由声明，包含“禁止打压/歧视工会代表”的专项条款；具备完善的集体谈判争议处理流程；披露了具体的集体合同关键条款及审议机制。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的政策承诺，具备工会或职工代表大会（职代会）组织，但缺乏深度的禁止打压机制说明或具体的集体协商争议解决程序。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视沟通”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：相关政策及集体合同覆盖 >80% 的员工或经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在国内主体执行而未覆盖海外子公司，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 结社自由 集体谈判 工会 集体合同 职工代表大会 劳资协商 禁止打压工会代表 集体协商 freedom of association collective bargaining trade union collective agreement works council labour-management negotiation non-retaliation against union representatives 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '结社自由与集体谈判'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工活动或文体协会；仅有“重视沟通”表述；仅有员工满意度调查；仅有申诉热线而无结社/集体谈判内容；区分：本指标关注结社自由与集体谈判权利；员工申诉机制是个体投诉渠道；童工/强迫劳动政策是人权底线禁令，不能替代集体谈判披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In the face of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Group worked with internal and external stakeholders to fight against the virus. In terms of employee safety, the Group set up emergency responding team, implemented flexible working hours, encourages virtual meetings to reduce the risk of employee exposure, and has provided epidemic prevention materials to employees and their families. Moreover, the Group's regional companies organized and distributed epidemic prevention materials to neighbouring schools, organized free medical consultations with property owners and epidemic prevention materials distribution activities.

Chairman's Statement

[Content]
In the face of the COVID-19 pandemic, the Group worked with internal and external stakeholders to fight against the virus. In terms of employee safety, the Group set up emergency responding team, implemented flexible working hours, encourages virtual meetings to reduce the risk of employee exposure, and has provided epidemic prevention materials to employees and their families. Moreover, the Group's regional companies organized and distributed epidemic prevention materials to neighbouring schools, organized free medical consultations with property owners and epidemic prevention materials distribution activities.

results.text: The Group is committed to operating its business with honesty, ethics, and integrity to ensure fair competition throughout its business operations. The Group adopts a zero-tolerance attitude towards any form of corruption, including bribery, extortion, fraud, and money laundering, and has established policies, such as the 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work System', 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work Guidelines', 'Intendance and Audit System', 'Tendering Management Methods' etc., stating the Group's expectations and demands towards our employees and cooperation partners. In addition, the Group implements 'Implementation Rules for Separation of Incompatible Positions' to reduce the risks of corruption and fraud under the principles of horizontal check and balance and vertical restriction. Each party should perform their respective duties and responsibilities under the mutual restraint to reduce the risk of corruption and fraud.

The Group makes all reasonable efforts to ensure all information for promotion or marketing comply with relevant government regulations and industry guidelines, and respects all property rights, including intellectual property rights.
